title: PESSOA TUTORA PLENO - (AGRONOMIA) FOCO EM AUDITORIA E INDICADORES
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.

Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

Como será seu dia a dia:

Você atuará diretamente no time de Auditoria dos cursos EAD Premium, garantindo a conformidade dos polos, a qualidade dos materiais laboratoriais e a validação dos processos acadêmicos relacionados às aulas práticas. A posição é voltada para profissionais com formação em Agronomia , assumindo como foco principal a auditoria e suporte desse curso, além de atuar de forma transversal nos demais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Desenvolver e gerenciar indicadores de desempenho para a área de negócios

- Realizar auditorias de laboratórios de polos e unidades.

- Orientação e comunicação com polos e unidades;

- Validação e acompanhamento de relatórios de aulas práticas.

- Analisar e interpretar dados e indicadores para identificar tendências e propor soluções

- Gerenciar projetos relacionados à área de negócios, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e objetivos

- Liderar equipes multidisciplinares em projetos de melhoria contínua

- Resolver problemas, utilizando metodologias de análise e resolução de problemas

- Comunicar-se de forma clara e objetiva com os stakeholders da área de negócios

Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação e agronomia, preferencialmente com Pós-graduação na área.

- Experiência ou conhecimento metodológicos de laboratórios;

- Familiaridade com insumos e equipamentos de laboratórios.

- Conhecimento avançado em gestão de indicadores

- Habilidade em comunicação e trabalho em equipe

- Capacidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas

- Conhecimento em metodologias de melhoria contínua

Informações adicionais:

Modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x na semana presenciais)

Temos alguns escritórios espalhados pelo Brasil, mas você ficará alocado em LONDRINA - TIETÊ.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos.

Venha enriquecer nosso time!

Como se candidatar:

  • Envie seu currículo e breve apresentação para com o assunto "Vaga Setor Orçamentos"
  • WhatsApp

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “ Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer (Flutter, C#/.NET)
description:
Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.

Role Description

We are seeking a  Full Stack Mobile Developer to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 

Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with  Flutter/Dart for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of  C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of  Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) implementation. 
  • Experience with  mobile battery optimization techniques for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with  Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with  Firebase (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics),  Sentry , and  PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

title: Especialista de RH
description:
No Grupo Iberostar estamos à procura de um profissional para atuar como Especialista de Recursos Humanos para se juntar à nossa equipe em Praia do Forte . Antes de saber mais sobre a vaga, achamos relevante compartilhar algumas informações sobre o Grupo Iberostar:

  • Somos uma empresa 100% familiar (mais concretamente, uma família de mais de 30.000 colaboradores).
  • Estamos presentes em 35 países e a nossa sede é em Palma de Maiorca.
  • Os nossos valores (Paixão, Responsabilidade, Transparência, Criatividade e Humildade) são muito importantes para nós e todas as nossas ações estão alinhadas com eles.
  • Somos pioneiros no turismo sustentável (veja o nosso movimento Wave of Change para saber mais).

Se isto lhe parece interessante... este pode ser o lugar certo para você! :)

Quais serão suas principais funções?

Recrutamento e Seleção

  • Auxílio e suporte estratégico às equipes de RH e gestão nas atividades de recrutamento e seleção.
  • Garantia do alinhamento dos processos de seleção com os objetivos organizacionais.

Treinamento e Desenvolvimento

  • Análise de Necessidades de Treinamento: Realizar análise aprofundada de lacunas de habilidades, conduzir entrevistas e analisar dados de desempenho para identificar necessidades e desenvolver planos de ação.
  • Desenvolvimento de Programas de Treinamento: Ser responsável pelo processo de Indução de novos colaboradores, projetar e implementar programas personalizados (como o PDL), criar conteúdos inovadores (incluindo manuais e vídeos) e adotar metodologias como gamificação e simulações.
  • Implementação de Treinamentos: Coordenar a logística, facilitar os treinamentos e fornecer feedback contínuo.
  • Avaliação e Relatórios: Medir a eficácia dos programas utilizando KPIs, analisar dados e apresentar relatórios detalhados sobre o impacto nos objetivos organizacionais.

Programas e Gestão de Pessoas

  • Programa de Acompanhamento de Novos Colaboradores: Acompanhar o desempenho, fornecer suporte e feedback regular, e avaliar periodicamente a eficácia do programa de integração.
  • Programa de Indução (onboarding)
  • Programas do RH (Ouvidoria e Comitê da Diversidade): Gerenciar e analisar demandas da ouvidoria (RH com Você!), garantindo confidencialidade e elaborando relatórios de melhorias, e acompanhar as reuniões do Comitê da Diversidade.
  • Gestão de Desligamento e Retenção: Conduzir entrevistas de desligamento para análise de fatores de saída e desenvolver/implementar estratégias de retenção de talentos e engajamento.
  • Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Gestão de Desempenho: Mapear necessidades de T&D, conduzir programas de desenvolvimento de carreira e atuar como consultor estratégico para a liderança.
  • Indicadores de Desempenho e Relatórios: Acompanhar KPIs de recrutamento, seleção, desenvolvimento e retenção, e gerar relatórios analíticos para a liderança.

O que é necessário para ter sucesso nesta função?

A pessoa ideal para este cargo possui excelentes habilidades de trabalho em equipe, é um bom comunicador. Tem capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia e rapidez na execução de processos. Possui capacidade de análise, habilidade de estruturar, sintetizar o conteúdo e montar apresentações harmoniosas e impactantes. É flexível e adaptável às novas circunstâncias da empresa e às diferentes mudanças organizacionais e possuir também as seguintes competências:

description:
Sobre a Gruen

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

Objetivo do Cargo: Garantir o planejamento eficiente e o acompanhamento detalhado de projetos de engenharia, assegurando que sejam executados dentro dos prazos, custos e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos. Será responsável por elaborar cronogramas, alocar recursos, monitorar o progresso dos projetos e mitigar riscos, visando a otimização de processos e a maximização da eficiência. Além disso, deve fornecer suporte estratégico para a alta gestão, por meio de relatórios e análises de desempenho, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões e a realização bem-sucedida dos projetos.

Atribuições:

  • Desenvolver planos de execução, cronogramas e alocação de recursos para garantir prazos e qualidade.
  • Monitorar o progresso do projeto, identificar riscos e desvios, e realizar ajustes quando necessário.
  • Elaborar orçamentos, controlar custos e realizar análises financeiras para garantir a viabilidade dos projetos.
  • Gerar relatórios de progresso, indicadores e dados para a diretoria.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos durante a execução dos projetos.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes multidisciplinares para garantir o cumprimento de prazos e qualidade.

  • Apoiar na elaboração e monitoramento de contratos, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos.

description:
Somos a Seguros Unimed, a Seguradora do Sistema Unimed, uma empresa criada por médicos e que tem o cooperativismo na essência. Cuidamos das instituições e das pessoas, para que possam viver bem o presente e planejar o futuro com segurança. Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer soluções completas, que potencializem novos negócios. E estamos ao lado dos nossos clientes na hora em que mais precisam. Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.

Pelo 7º ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025, da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!

Siga nossa página aqui no LinkedIn e fique por dentro de nossas oportunidades de carreira.

Venha fazer parte da Seguros Unimed e ter uma Jornada Incrível conosco!

O que oferecemos nessa Jornada:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Vale transporte ou estacionamento conveniado;
  • Seguro Saúde;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Garantia Funeral;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Gympass e Totalpass;
  • Happy Day - um dia de folga no aniversário.

Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento Profissional;
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Inovador;
  • Oportunidades de Crescimento na Organização;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.

No seu dia-a-dia:

  • Identificação e Avaliação de Riscos: Proativamente identificar, analisar e classificar os riscos corporativos (Específicos, Operacionais, Financeiros e Regulatórios) de média e alta complexidade, utilizando metodologias de Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) .
  • Desenvolvimento de Metodologias: Atuar na manutenção e aprimoramento da metodologia de Gestão de Riscos, incluindo a Matriz de Riscos, o Apetite ao Risco e o estabelecimento de Limites de Risco (KRI - Key Risk Indicators ).
  • Monitoramento e Reporting: Acompanhar e consolidar os principais indicadores de risco (KRIs) da Companhia, elaborando relatórios analíticos e apresentações estratégicas para o Comitê de Riscos e Alta Gestão.
  • Análise de Cenários: Conduzir análises de stress testing e deep dive em áreas críticas, avaliando o impacto potencial de eventos de risco e propondo planos de mitigação robustos.
  • Articulação com Controles Internos: Atuar com a área de Controles Internos na integração dos riscos mapeados com o desenho e a avaliação da eficácia dos controles, garantindo uma visão holística (GRC - Governança, Risco e Auditoria).
  • Iniciativas e Projetos: Participar como ponto focal de Risco em projetos e novas iniciativas de negócio, avaliando, desde a concepção, os riscos inerentes e os requisitos de controle.
  • Cultura de Riscos: Atuar ativamente na disseminação da cultura de gestão de riscos por meio de treinamentos, workshops e orientação às áreas de negócio.

Conformidade Regulatória: Assegurar que os processos de gestão de riscos estejam em total conformidade com as normas regulatórias aplicáveis ao setor (ex: ANS, SUSEP).

Esperamos de você:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em áreas como Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou correlatas.
  • Experiência Sólida e Comprovada (nível Pleno) em Gestão de Riscos (ERM), Auditoria Interna, ou Controles Internos.
  • Conhecimento e aplicação prática de frameworks de Risco (e.g., COSO ERM, ISO 31000 ).
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais .
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos e áreas de negócio.

Consideramos diferencial:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA na área de Finanças, Risco ou Compliance.
  • Certificações profissionais como CRMA, FRM, PRMIA ou correlatas.
  • Conhecimento e vivência no mercado Segurador SUSEP/ANS Saúde / Odonto / Vida / Previdência.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC ( Governance, Risk, and Controles Internos ).
  • Conhecimento em Gestão e Continuidade de Negócio.

Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT;
  • Local de trabalho: São Paulo - SP
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente on-line nas etapas iniciais.

A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

title: Líder florestal
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

  • Garantir a execução dos procedimentos corporativos com interface nas unidades.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos processos em conformidade com os controles internos.

With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. title: NGS Technical Sales Specialist | Genomics & Life Sciences (Brazil)
description:
About the Opportunity

Are you a scientist at heart, passionate about genomics and the power of technology to transform healthcare?

At MGI , we combine scientific excellence with innovation to redefine what’s possible in genetic sequencing and automation.

We’re seeking a NGS Technical Sales Specialist who blends a strong scientific foundation with a consultative commercial mindset — someone who can speak the language of researchers, understand their challenges, and guide them toward solutions that accelerate discovery.

What You’ll Do

Drive Scientific Engagement & Growth

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan for MGI’s sequencing and automation portfolio.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities within universities, hospitals, research institutes, and biotech companies.
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key opinion leaders and research partners.

Act as a Scientific Partner

  • Provide consultative pre- and post-sales support to ensure customers achieve optimal experimental outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Field Application Scientists to deliver a seamless scientific and technical experience.
  • Conduct presentations, workshops, and seminars to demonstrate the impact of MGI technologies on research and clinical applications.

Market Intelligence & Collaboration

  • Stay ahead of market trends in genomics, molecular biology, and precision medicine to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Represent MGI at scientific conferences, trade shows, and regional events as a trusted partner in the life sciences community.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, and R&D to align customer feedback with product innovation.

Reporting & Planning

  • Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, and customer records using CRM tools (Salesforce).
  • Monitor performance metrics and adjust strategies to meet and exceed objectives.

Who You Are

  • A scientist with commercial curiosity — passionate about both research and relationship building.
  • Strong communicator who can translate complex scientific concepts into clear, compelling discussions.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Driven by the opportunity to make genomics more accessible and impactful for all.

What You Bring

Scientific Expertise

  • Solid understanding of genomics, molecular biology, or biotechnology .
  • Hands-on experience with NGS workflows, DNA/RNA sequencing, or lab automation .

Commercial Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in life science sales, business development, or field-based scientific roles .
  • Proven record of achieving or exceeding sales goals through consultative, science-driven engagement.

Education & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related field required; Master’s or Ph.D. preferred .
  • English: Advanced | Spanish: Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite .
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across Brazil.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance .
  • Meal stipend and fitness allowance to support wellbeing.

About MGI

MGI is a global leader in genomics innovation, delivering advanced sequencing and automation solutions that empower scientists and healthcare professionals worldwide.

Our mission is to make high-quality, affordable genomics accessible to all — enabling discoveries that improve lives and transform the future of medicine.

Join us and help shape the next generation of genomics.

title: Operador(a) Painel de Linha de Fibras
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Operar, por meio do Sistema Digital de Controle Distribuído (SDCD), os processos de Cozimento, Depuração e Lavagem de Massa Marrom, Deslignificação, Branqueamento e demais áreas e recursos correlacionados. Gerir tecnicamente seu turno, orientando a equipe de Operadores de Área nas diversas atividades operacionais, visando o adequado atendimento às demandas e objetivos da área e da empresa tais como, a preservação do Meio Ambiente e a Segurança, volume de produção com qualidade, eficiência e custos operacionais. Reportar as anomalias de processo e auxiliar na gestão e desenvolvimento dos operadores de área.

Principais Atividades:

  • Operar e monitorar a linha de fibras, garantindo estabilidade do processo, qualidade do produto, segurança e eficiência operacional.
  • Gerir o turno, assegurar boa comunicação nas trocas de turno e fornecer informações essenciais para suporte às decisões da gestão.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho, identificar desvios e atuar prontamente na correção, orientando operadores de área e garantindo o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais e de segurança.
  • Facilitar e acompanhar atividades de manutenção corretiva e preventiva, identificando e reportando anomalias.
  • Participar ativamente de programas corporativos, reuniões de equipe, DDS, análises de falhas e comitês de segurança.
  • Conduzir reuniões diárias do turno e elaborar relatórios operacionais completos, assegurando a rastreabilidade das informações.
  • Monitorar fatores que impactam a qualidade, evitando retrabalhos e perdas de produto.
  • Atuar em paradas programadas e não programadas, garantindo liberações seguras de equipamentos e sistemas.
  • Zelar pelos ativos da área e assegurar a operação dentro dos padrões estabelecidos.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento da equipe, acompanhar desempenho dos operadores do turno e contribuir para sua capacitação técnica.
  • Interagir com demais áreas da fábrica, mantendo integração e alinhamento entre processos.
  • Estar disponível para atividades administrativas e apoio a projetos, testes e melhorias de processo quando necessário.
  • Em situações de emergência, atuar imediatamente para interromper processos ou atividades que representem risco.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Curso técnico completo em Papel e Celulose, Química, e/ou afins;
  • Desejável ensino superior em Administração, Engenharias e afins;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office, SAP, Ferramentas BI;
  • Vivência em Comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Conhecimentos intermediário dos processos de Cozimento, Depuração e Lavagem de polpa marrom e Branqueamento de celulose;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de controle e automação industrial, especialmente SDCD (Sistema Digital de Controle Distribuído);
  • Noções de instrumentação industrial (sensores, transmissores, atuadores) relevantes para as áreas;
  • Experiência com análise de dados de processo para identificação de tendências e desvios;
  • Conhecimento com balanço de massa e licor;
  • Inglês e Espanhol será um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Inocência/MS.

description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.

Our team:

Our program has 10+ years and has over 300 team members distributed in several countries

Technologies used:

Python, C++, Linux

Responsibilities:

As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.

A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.

During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.

The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.

Mandatory Skills Description:

We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.

Python: application coding

Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting

Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.

Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

CI/CD using Jenkins or Git Actions (as a user and occasional trouble shooting)

Familiarity with UT, BDD and test automation

Familiarity or willing to work with a process where documentation is required (requirements, design, testing).

Google test framework

Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Project Manager

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Provide overall project communication to stakeholders and meet project requirements and stakeholder expectations
  • Serves as primary point of contact with the customer of the project and keeps customer appraised of project progress
  • Manage and oversee all project activities, such as issue tracking and risk mitigation, facilitating project team meetings and preparing/delivering status reports

  • Coordinate and perform review of the project deliverables, software and hardware, and report on project performance
  • Manage and plan with the Systems Engineering and Product/Engineering team leads for technical review of system design and documentation with the customer
  • Establishes a project plan and schedules according to established company practices, polices, tools and templates.
  • Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to program master plans
  • Manages financial schedule performance of assigned projects
  • Maintains and keeps scheduling of assigned projects and communicates schedule changes as necessary
  • Manages full lifecycle of project and ensures each aspect of the project is completed
  • Manages procurement of equipment and materials necessary to execute on projects
  • Develops subcontractors’ scopes of work, executes subcontracts and manages subcontractors as may be necessary
  • Coordinates with Sales and Account Managers to further sales opportunities
  • May coordinate proposal preparation, including standards of work and specifications, estimation of product and service costs.
  • May participate in negotiation and administration of contracts
  • Travel required for onsite at customers facility up to 40%
  • Adheres to company processes and policies.

Skills Required:

  • 10+ years’ experience as a Project Manager in a technical or engineering environment with a focus on delivering projects to external customers.
  • B.S. Degree and or 5+ Years as a Project Manager in and ITS environment
  • PMP certification or equivalent preferred.
  • Experience in transit industry.
  • Strong computer skills, including MS Office Suite, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook as well as ability to learn new software programs such as Microsoft Dynamics AX
  • Strong team building and leadership skills. Ability to lead the team.
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Strong time management skills and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong verbal and written communications, presentation, and persuasive skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong negotiation and influence skills

description:
*Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

*Nosso cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente que é fornecedor de tecnologias e equipamentos submarinos.

Buscamos um líder para cuidar de duas frentes. São elas:

Frente 1 - Gestão de pessoas - Ponto focal de uma equipe administrativa formada por 5 pessoas - Será responsável por distribuir as atividades do time, gerir o ponto, dar feedback, organizar banco de horas e férias. Garantirá também que a instalação (escritório) onde esses profissionais trabalham estejam em bom estado e perfeito funcionamento.

Frente 2 - Cuidará da gestão de contratos (acompanha e fiscaliza contratos de manutenção - acompanha cronogramas envolvendo manutenção preventiva e corretiva). Muito importante o conhecimento de manutenção predial. Trabalhará com orçamentos, indicadores e relacionamento com o cliente. Atuará sendo a ponte de contato e aproximação da consultoria com o cliente.

  • Gestão de pessoas – Desde distribuição das atividades até feedback, plano de desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Rotinas administrativas envolvendo o time – Ponto, banco de horas, férias;
  • Manutenção corretiva das instalações do escritório – Contratação de fornecedores para que realizem as atividades e garantia de que as instalações funcionem corretamente e estejam em bom estado. Acompanha manutenção, segue cronogramas;

*O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com gestão de times – desde a parte de feedback e desenvolvimento até controle de ponto e férias;

  • Bagagem anterior com gestão de contratos, orçamentos, indicadores e relacionamento com o cliente;

- Desejáveis

title: Senior Engineering Specialist
description:
About the Company:

Munksjö is a leading international manufacturer of decorative papers for coating wood-based panel surfaces. Our mission is to create comfortable living and working environments, and taking responsibility for the future of our planet is our top priority.

We develop and offer innovative and customized solutions in decorative papers, which after additional processing are used in the production of furniture, laminate flooring, and surface materials for both indoor and outdoor applications.

Job Description:

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Specialist to work in the Engineering Department on multidisciplinary projects, supporting the Project Coordinator in the development and execution of industrial projects especially in the areas of mechanics, piping, static and rotating equipment, and Paper Machine equipment. This professional will have strong interfaces with Maintenance, Utilities, Process, and Operations teams, being responsible for the technical leadership of capital projects, ensuring safety, quality, and delivery within schedule and budget, while contributing to the transformation of the department and the implementation of engineering best practices across the company.

Responsibilities:

  • Work on multidisciplinary projects applying PMBOK best practices and using the FEL methodology;
  • Ensure project deadlines, costs, and scope are met and aligned with plant expectations;
  • Develop and review engineering documents: design reports, data sheets, specifications, technical scopes, material lists, RFQs, P&IDs, and other technical documents;
  • Prepare and validate designs for industrial equipment, Paper Machine technologies, industrial piping, pressure vessels, and mechanical devices in general;
  • Monitor suppliers and contractors, ensuring technical compliance, safety, and quality;
  • Provide direct support to the CAPEX Project Coordinator in managing schedule, cost, risk, and project governance;
  • Technically lead studies, analyses, and improvements in industrial equipment and processes;
  • Define solutions involving materials, corrosion, hydraulics, energy, utilities, and chemical processes;
  • Perform critical analyses of technical proposals and conduct technical equalizations;
  • Support inspections (FAT/SAT), safety audits, and field validations;
  • Strongly promote the process safety culture, ensuring compliance with standards, regulations, and global best practices.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related fields;
  • Experience in the Chemical, Oil & Gas, Pulp & Paper, or Energy industries;
  • Experience in large-scale projects, such as plant expansions, general shutdowns, etc.;
  • Knowledge of project management and governance methodologies: PMBOK, FEL, and CAPEX.

Other Requirements:

  • Experience using AutoCAD, Inventor, Plant 3D, MS Project, advanced Excel, and Power BI;
  • Strong expertise in industrial piping, material specification and sizing, pumping systems, hydraulics, process systems, static and rotating equipment, and team coordination.

Differentials:

  • MBA in Project Management;
  • Advanced English.

  • PPR (Profit Sharing Program)
  • Additional Fixed Bonus
  • Transportation Voucher and Shuttle Service
  • On-site Parking
  • Support for Language Courses, Undergraduate and Graduate Studies

title: Operador(a) de Produção de Painéis IV (MDF)
description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Responder por executar e conduzir as atividades das linhas de produção em que atua, contribuindo para que os produtos estejam dentro das especificações definidas e prezando pelo cumprimento dos requisitos de qualidade, segurança e proteção ao meio ambiente;

  • Realizar apontamentos das informações sobre segurança, qualidade, produtividade e consumo reportando ao superior imediato as não conformidades e sugestões de melhoria;

  • Participar da rotina semanal de limpeza de equipamentos críticos;

Requisitos:

title: Tech Lead (Chatbot Development)
description:
Sinch is at the forefront of transforming customer communications, offering innovative solutions that empower businesses around the globe. We are looking for a Tech Lead specializing in Conversational Solutions to guide our talented engineers and help shape our cutting-edge platforms.

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing and enhancing our conversational AI solutions, integrating advanced technologies such as NLP and machine learning to deliver exceptional user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of conversational solutions, including chatbots and voice initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • Architect and design scalable systems that can handle real-time interactions and integrate various channels of communication.
  • Guide and mentor a team of engineers, promoting best practices and innovation in software development.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver high-quality products.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in conversational AI and incorporate relevant advancements into Sinch's offerings.
  • Ensure robust testing and deployment processes, maintaining high standards of code quality and system reliability.
  • Actively contribute to the team's success by driving initiatives, providing technical guidance, and fostering a collaborative environment.

Requirements

  • Experience performing as technical lead of Software Development team.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in software development, with a strong focus on AI and conversational solutions.
  • Expertise in programming Low Code (Dialogue Flow, IBM Watson), NodeJS, JavaScript, Golang ou outras linguagens microsservices
  • Experience with NLP technologies and frameworks (e.g., Rasa, Dialogflow, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of microservices, cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proven experience in leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, and driving collaborative projects.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a passion for developing innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English
  • Experience with real-time messaging platforms and API integrations.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management tools.

Benefits

Sinch is a global company composed of people from different countries and cultures. Our benefits adjust regionally to support employees and help them to thrive in every stage of life. We offer valuable benefits and resources, including health and life insurance, a flexible work environment, retirement savings plans, and more.

  • STAY HEALTHY: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • FLEXIBLE BENEFITS: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • FAMILY FIRST: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • EVERYDAY WELLBEING: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • TAKE A BREAK: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

This role is central to delivering high-quality customer service within a 24/7 operational environment in the iGaming and digital entertainment industry. title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).

  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

title: Plant Manager. Cabo de Santo Agostinho.
description:
Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin Brazil: Where purpose comes to life.

You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose ‘to advance life around the world’ drives our entire global team.

Every day, we are thinking big and working smart to solve some of the toughest challenges impacting the world. Whether it’s facilitating clean drinking water for communities, creating climate resilient cities, or designing more comfortable living spaces, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better.

Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?

At Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments. And where is our help most needed? The places we live in: cities where drinking water is leaking away, greenery is disappearing, streets are flooding after heavy rain, and outdated sewer systems are polluting our groundwater. It’s time to join our team and help build more sustainable environments!

We are currently looking for a Plant Manager to join us at Cabo de Santo Agostinho, Pernambuco, Brazil, in the Suape industrial complex . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.

About the role:

The plant manager is responsible for managing the daily operations of the plant . This includes planning and coordinating production activities, managing a team of production department heads, supervisors and workers, and ensuring that the plant operates safely and efficiently. The production plant manager will also be responsible for controlling plant costs, improving production efficiency, and establishing and maintaining relationships with suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee plant operations such as budget, production schedule and stock.
  • Analyze production costs and inventory to establish areas for improvements
  • Ensure adherence to rules and workplace policies and HSE.
  • Lead improvement initiatives as aligned with global guidance , such as Lean and Operational Excellence , and other projects to improve quality, reduce costs, improve OEE, save time.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or relevant field. (Nice to have: Lean Six Sigma certification)
  • 5+ years of experience in field as a Plan Manager in manufacturing (i n Plastic transformation processes).
  • Professional English level ( is a key requirement), the interviews will be in English
  • Experience in plant management and manufacturing operations, budget, Strong communication, management and supervisory skills.
  • The candidate will also have an ability to follow safety and compliance guidelines diligently in order to create a healthy work environment for all employees.

What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers

Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B&I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.

Organization

Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it’s to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B&I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B&I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.

Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

title: Country Leader, Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.

The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.g., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program; adapt strategy proactively

2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities; b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure; c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators; and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.

3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.

4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.

5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.

6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized; access to waste management; jobs created; safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.

7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).

Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

description:

title: Government Relations Director, Brazil
description:
SHEIN

Founded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,

Singapore, Los Angeles, and other key markets around the world. SHEIN reaches consumers

in more than 150 locations globally, enabling them to access more fashion, beauty and

lifestyle products easily and conveniently, at affordable prices. Our mission is to help

everyone - regardless of their location, body size, ethnicity, income level - express their

individuality through access to the latest trends.

SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,

collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to

come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and

enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN’s growth and expansion globally, making

it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.

Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN’s business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN’s various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.

In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN’s corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.

Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN’s commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN’s senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN’s network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company’s overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management’s reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

description:
Resumo da vaga

Estamos em busca de um Application Service Manager (SAP) experiente para atuar na gestão de aplicações corporativas, garantindo a estabilidade, desempenho e governança dos sistemas em um ambiente complexo e global.

O profissional será responsável por supervisionar o ciclo de vida das aplicações, gestão de fornecedores, controle de custos operacionais (OPEX) e conformidade com políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Esta função exige forte capacidade de coordenação entre times técnicos e de negócio, experiência com ambiente SAP e tecnologias corporativas, além de habilidade para atuar em ambientes altamente regulados e orientados por SLAs.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão de aplicações:

Gerenciar o ciclo de vida das aplicações, incluindo monitoramento, tratamento de incidentes, manutenção e descontinuação de sistemas.

  • Governança e desempenho:

Definir e acompanhar KPIs e SLAs, garantindo a continuidade do negócio e a excelência na entrega de serviços.

  • Segurança e conformidade:

Assegurar que as aplicações estejam em conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, proteção de dados e auditorias internas/externas.

  • Gestão de fornecedores:

Atuar como ponto focal na relação com fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, monitorando SLAs contratuais e conduzindo renovações.

  • Gestão financeira (OPEX):

Controlar orçamento, custos operacionais, previsões financeiras e identificar oportunidades de otimização de custos.

  • Gestão de mudanças:

Supervisionar a implantação de releases, patches e atualizações, assegurando a execução correta dos processos de change management.

  • Colaboração técnica:

Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de arquitetura, segurança, times DevOps e “Function Towers” para garantir prontidão operacional antes do go-live.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em TI: Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em Operações de TI ou Gestão de Aplicações em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento em SAP: Vivência em ambientes com SAP (ECC ou S/4HANA) e entendimento de integrações entre módulos e sistemas.
  • Governança de serviços: Conhecimento sólido em ITIL, gestão de SLAs, KPIs e boas práticas de gestão de serviços de TI.
  • Gestão de fornecedores: Experiência com gestão de contratos, acompanhamento de performance e negociação de melhorias de serviço.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Familiaridade com Azure, Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, ferramentas de monitoramento (Datadog, Grafana) e sistemas de chamados (ex.: ServiceNow) será um diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado é essencial.
  • Perfil comportamental: Fortes habilidades de comunicação, organização, visão analítica e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .

In this role you will:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.

To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
  • Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
  • Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
  • Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
  • Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure IoT/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
  • Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
  • Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
  • Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.

Additional Comments:

This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.
